learningPath.title: 7-Day Hands-On Path
learningPath.subtitle: One project per day, zero to productive. Follow along, and in 7 days you'll have a fully automated personal AI assistant.

day1.title: Install & First Reply
day1.description: One Docker command to install OpenClaw. Connect an LLM and get your first AI reply.

day2.title: Connect Telegram
day2.description: Create a Telegram bot, connect to OpenClaw, customize AI persona, and master context & memory.

day3.title: Code & File Operations
day3.description: Enable file access, let AI read code, generate scripts, and execute them. Build a real utility tool.

day4.title: Feishu / WeChat / DingTalk
day4.description: Connect Chinese platforms. Deploy to Alibaba or Tencent Cloud. Configure Chinese-friendly LLMs.

day5.title: Install Skills
day5.description: Install web search, GitHub, weather skills from ClawHub. Build a morning briefing workflow.

day6.title: Automation
day6.description: Set up scheduled briefings, proactive alerts, conditional monitoring. Let AI work 24/7 for you.

day7.title: Advanced: Multi-Agent & Custom Skills
day7.description: Orchestrate multiple AIs, browser automation, build and publish your own custom skill from scratch.
